summary: The single-page 2010 sheet geometry matches the official PDF well, but Part II and Schedule 1.1 amounts are left-aligned, Attachment Withholding Agent Name and Seq. No. are blank, Item 11 No is unticked, and screen Part II shows a row-count mismatch.

defects.where: Page 1, Part II Items 12-16 and Schedule 1.1 columns (6) and (8)
defects.what: All peso amounts print left-aligned instead of right-aligned.

defects.where: Page 1, Attachment header (Withholding Agent Name) and Schedule 1.1 (Seq. No. and Total row)
defects.what: Withholding Agent Name in the Attachment header prints blank; Schedule 1.1 Seq. No. column (1) is blank; only 5 of 10 filled payee rows print; Total row P boxes are blank.

defects.where: Page 1, Item 10 (Zip Code) and Item 11 (Tax Relief)
defects.what: Item 10 Zip Code prints blank; Item 11 No box is unticked on paper even though screen Part I states eBIRForms keeps it disabled with No ticked.

defects.where: Part II, Computation of Tax table
defects.what: Header displays "2 rows" while the table body states "No rows yet.".

shared_changes_wanted: crates/bir-print: tighten 14-digit TIN comb spacing in Attachment header so digits do not touch ticks
